title: Deep Learning Based RF Fingerprint Identification Using Differential Constellation Trace Figure

experimental_conditions.noise: AWGN added to emulate varying SNR levels

data_split.partitioning: Random split for training and validation

proposed_method.name: DCTF-CNN
proposed_method.description: Deep learning-based RF fingerprint identification using Differential Constellation Trace Figure (DCTF)

primary_performance.experimental_condition: 54 target ZigBee devices under an SNR level of 30 dB

additional_results.evaluation_condition: 54 target ZigBee devices under an SNR level of 15 dB

limitations.description: Future work includes studying target movements in DCTF-CNN identification.

evidence.quote: The future work includes study of target movements in DCTF-CNN identification.

dataset.section: III. EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN / A. Experiment Setup & B. ZigBee Burst Collection
dataset.statement: L=54 TI CC2530 system-on-chip ZigBee modules are employed as the target devices to be classified.

primary_performance.statement: Experimental results have demonstrated that the proposed DCTF-CNN can achieve an identification accuracy as high as 99.1% and 93.8% under SNR levels of 30 dB and 15 dB, respectively, when classifying 54 target ZigBee devices.
